candidate_hypotheses.title: Lahontan-Deconfounded Piedmont Scarp Profile-Curvature Dipole coupled with GeoDAWN Radiometric K/Th/U/TC Provenance-Metasomatism Step and Seismic-Conductance Conduit
layers: training_features.tif Band 6 (tc: pixel-verified GeoDAWN Airborne Radiometric Total Count TC, r=+0.997140 vs geodawn_rad_u8.tif Band 4 TC)
data/external/geodawn_rad_u8.tif Band 1 (K), Band 2 (Th), Band 3 (U), Band 4 (TC) (USGS GeoDAWN DOI 10.5066/P93LGLVQ)
training_features.tif Band 12 (det_elev: Detrended elevation) & Band 19 (det_elev_slope: Detrended elevation slope)
data/external/topo_10m_derived_100m_u8.tif Band 6 (curv_prof_absmax) & Band 9 (dem_mean for Lake Lahontan shoreline contour deconfounding)
training_features.tif Band 10 (deq_n100a15: Distance to earthquake) & Band 16 (ieq_n100a15: Earthquake intensity/density)
candidate_hypotheses.physical_signature: Co-located (1) asymmetric piedmont profile-curvature dipole (-div(grad(B12)/||grad(B12)||) + 10m 3DEP curv_prof_absmax gated by piedmont slope window in B19 and suppressed along Pleistocene Lake Lahontan contour-parallel strandlines in topo_10m Band 9 dem_mean), (2) strike-concordant cross-scarp gradient in immobile-normalized potassium metasomatism index R_K_Th = z(geodawn K) - 0.85*z(geodawn Th) and Total Count B6 (tc), and (3) seismic-geodetic-argillic conduit favorability from B4, B7, B8, B10, B16, and B17.
candidate_hypotheses.why_catches_unmapped_faults: Late-Quaternary piedmont and intrabasin fault scarps diffused below ~1-2 m vertical relief over 10^4-10^5 yr are systematically missed by aerial-photo compilation in USGS/INGENIOUS, yet still juxtapose distinct footwall vs. hanging-wall alluvial radioelement provenance (K, Th, U, TC), focus K-metasomatic illite/adularia alteration along the fault damage zone, and preserve a 300-600 m piedmont profile-curvature inflection.
candidate_hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan wave-cut constructional strandlines and non-tectonic alluvial fan boundary channels between adjacent drainages draining potassic ash-flow tuffs vs. intermediate volcanics.
candidate_hypotheses.difference_from_repo: Excludes all gravity (Bands 5, 11, 13, 15, 18) and magnetic (Bands 1, 2, 3, 9, 14) layers that underpinned H86E-MMT, H86F-PCC, H86F-GZZD, and H86H-PSTD; operates as a 100% catalogue-blind, zero-parameter radiometric-geomorphic-seismotectonic operator rather than the 48-62 feature supervised HGB + visible-catalogue relay models of H86C-KSLB and H86D-CTHB.
candidate_hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low-Medium (9 verified training_features.tif bands + pinned GeoDAWN K/Th/U/TC & 10m 3DEP rasters, O(N) Gaussian derivative & structure-tensor operators)

candidate_hypotheses.title: Shallow-Conductance Smectite Cap to Seismic-Swarm Upflow Lateral Offset across Dipping Basement Faults
candidate_hypotheses.physical_signature: Cross-strike dipole coupling where earthquake density/proximity (B16, B10) at seismogenic depth is laterally offset 200-800 m in the down-dip hanging-wall direction (grad B15) from a shallow electrical conductance smectite cap (B17).
candidate_hypotheses.why_catches_unmapped_faults: Blind intrabasin geothermal faults beneath zero-relief playas leave no surface scarp, but fluid upflow along a 50-65 deg dipping fault plane creates a diagnostic down-dip separation between deep microseismicity and the shallow argillic alteration cap.
candidate_hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Closed-basin evaporite playa brines sitting laterally adjacent to buried volcanic centers without brittle fault conduits.
candidate_hypotheses.difference_from_repo: Targets the directed lateral spatial phase offset between B16/B10 and B17 along the B15 dip vector, unlike point-wise scalar tree splits in H86C-KSLB or potential-field curvature in H86F-GZZD/H86H-PSTD.
candidate_hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low (5 in-repo bands, directional shift cross-correlation)

candidate_hypotheses.title: Mohr-Coulomb Transtensional Stress-Ratio Obliquity Coupled with Microseismic Lineament Tensor and Conductance Boundaries
candidate_hypotheses.physical_signature: Spin-2 angular alignment between the structure tensor of earthquake density (B16) and lateral conductance gradients (B17), weighted by the transtensional strain product z(B7)*sigmoid(z(B8)).
candidate_hypotheses.why_catches_unmapped_faults: Nascent strike-slip and transtensional accommodation zones (e.g., Walker Lane / Humboldt structural belt) have minimal vertical throw and weak gravity steps, but exhibit aligned microseismicity and fluid-conductivity boundaries.
candidate_hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Swarm seismicity induced by geothermal injection/production or volcanic diking unrelated to through-going tectonic faults.
candidate_hypotheses.difference_from_repo: Uses seismic-conductance spin-2 tensor alignment with zero topographic, gravity, or magnetic inputs.

candidate_hypotheses.title: Sentinel-1 / ARIA Ascending-Descending InSAR Interseismic Strain Gradient & Poroelastic Aquifer-Barrier Phase Jump
layers: External NASA JPL ARIA / ASF DAAC Sentinel-1 GUNW unwrapped interferograms & COMET LiCSAR velocity fields (90 m)
External USGS NWIS / Nevada Division of Water Resources seasonal piezometric head records
candidate_hypotheses.physical_signature: Horizontal velocity gradient step (||grad v_LOS|| > 1.5 mm/yr/km) co-located with a seasonal poroelastic vertical phase discontinuity across fault-gouge hydraulic barriers in alluvial basins.
candidate_hypotheses.why_catches_unmapped_faults: Directly images active aseismic creep and groundwater compartmentalization across Holocene playas where erosion/aggradation erases topographic scarps.
candidate_hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Stratigraphic clay-silt facies pinchouts in agricultural pumping cones (e.g., Mason Valley, Fallon, Lovelock).
candidate_hypotheses.difference_from_repo: Requires multi-temporal satellite radar interferometry rather than static geophysical or topographic rasters.
candidate_hypotheses.official_data_obtainability: NOT_VIABLE_IN_SANDBOX_YET: Official free sources are NASA ASF DAAC (https://search.asf.alaska.edu/) and COMET LiCSAR (https://comet.nerc.ac.uk/COMET-LiCS-portal/), which are blocked by the sandbox outbound allowlist (github.com, codeload.github.com, api.github.com, registry.npmjs.org, pypi.org, files.pythonhosted.org) and are not mirrored in data/external/.

experiment_arms.description: Full H86I-RKSC operator: Lahontan-deconfounded piedmont scarp profile-curvature dipole coupled with strike-aligned GeoDAWN radiometric K/Th/U/TC provenance-metasomatism gradient and seismic-geodetic-argillic conduit favorability; emitted at 44,090 dots via shared 3-px decimated emitter with >3 px visible/catalogue collar.

Radiometric-geomorphic ablation: Lahontan-deconfounded piedmont scarp profile-curvature dipole + GeoDAWN radiometric K/Th/U/TC provenance-metasomatism step without seismic/geodetic/conductance coupling; emitted at 44,090 dots.

Negative control removing Lake Lahontan shoreline contour deconfounding and inverting the K/Th metasomatic polarity to test whether shoreline-suppression and potassic enrichment polarity contribute positively on holdout; emitted at 44,090 dots.
